title: KKR launches $10 billion AI infrastructure company with Nvidia, Vistra
title_zh: KKR 与 Nvidia、Vistra 成立价值 100 亿美元的人工智能基础设施公司
summary: A KKR-led group on Thursday launched a new company with more than $10 billion in committed ‌capital to finance the build-out of AI infrastructure, ‌the latest effort by an alternative asset manager to capitalize on growing demand ​for AI services.
summary_zh: 周四，KKR 领导的一个集团成立了一家新公司，承诺资本超过 100 亿美元，为人工智能基础设施的建设提供资金，这是另类资产管理公司为利用人工智能服务不断增长的需求而做出的最新努力。

title: Why the SpaceX, OpenAI, and Anthropic IPOs won't derail the bull market
title_zh: 为什么 SpaceX、OpenAI 和 Anthropic 的 IPO 不会破坏牛市
summary: Don't fret about a lot of stock coming to market, Goldman Sachs contends.
summary_zh: 高盛认为，不必担心大量股票进入市场。

title: SpaceX IPO set to 'price' Thursday night ahead of Friday Nasdaq debut — here's what's next
title_zh: SpaceX IPO 定于周四晚在周五纳斯达克上市前“定价”——接下来会发生什么
summary: SpaceX's record-breaking IPO enters its final stretch, with the deal set to "price" Thursday night ahead of the stock's debut on the Nasdaq on Friday, June 12. But this pricing night will look nothing like the ones Wall Street, and investors, are used to.
summary_zh: SpaceX 破纪录的 IPO 进入最后阶段，交易定于周四晚上在该股 6 月 12 日周五在纳斯达克上市之前进行“定价”。但这个定价之夜与华尔街和投资者所习惯的不同。

title: 'Magnificent 7' stocks have lost $2 trillion so far this month, driving the S&P 500 decline: Chart of the Day
title_zh: 本月迄今为止，“Magnificent 7”股票已损失 2 万亿美元，推动标准普尔 500 指数下跌：每日图表
summary: The group has erased roughly $1.8 trillion in market value this month, while the rest of the S&P 500 is still holding up.
summary_zh: 该集团本月市值蒸发了约 1.8 万亿美元，而标准普尔 500 指数的其他成分股仍然坚挺。

title: SpaceX IPO Will Mint Billions for a New Silicon Valley Hierarchy
title_zh: SpaceX IPO 将为新硅谷阶层创造数十亿美元
summary: (Bloomberg) -- The initial public offering for SpaceX is poised to generate billions of dollars in profits for the fortunate few investors who got in early on Elon Musk’s rocket, satellite and artificial intelligence company.Most Read from BloombergHouse Republican Says Hegset...
summary_zh: （彭博社）——SpaceX 的首次公开募股有望为早期进入埃隆·马斯克的火箭、卫星和人工智能公司的少数幸运投资者带来数十亿美元的利润。彭博社的大多数共和党人表示，赫格塞特……

title: CoreWeave’s Credit Rebound Spurs Cheaper Data Center Funding
title_zh: CoreWeave 的信贷反弹刺激了数据中心融资成本的降低
summary: (Bloomberg) -- When Applied Digital Corp. first tapped the junk-bond market in November to fund a data center project tied to CoreWeave Inc., it had to stomach a hefty yield to get the deal done.
summary_zh: （彭博社）——当 Applied Digital Corp. 在 11 月份首次利用垃圾债券市场为与 CoreWeave Inc. 相关的数据中心项目提供资金时，它必须承受高昂的收益率才能完成交易。

title: Amazon vs. transport stocks, DraftKings sees prediction markets boost
title_zh: 亚马逊与运输股，DraftKings 预测预测市场提振
summary: Yahoo Finance Senior Autos Reporter Pras Subramanian and Market Domination host Josh Lipton take a closer look at some of Wednesday's trending tickers and stories. Transportation stocks are plunging as Amazon (AMZN) expands its truckload offerings.
summary_zh: 雅虎财经高级汽车记者 Pras Subramanian 和《市场支配》主持人 Josh Lipton 仔细研究了周三的一些热门行情和故事。随着亚马逊（AMZN）扩大卡车运输服务，运输类股暴跌。

title: Big Tech is dragging the S&P 500 lower in June
title_zh: 6 月份大型科技股拖累标普 500 指数走低
summary: Big Tech stocks are having a rough go of it in June as the Magnificent Seven drags the broader market down with it (^DJI, ^IXIC, ^GSPC).
summary_zh: 大型科技股在 6 月份经历了一段艰难的时期，七巨头拖累了更广泛的市场（^DJI、^IXIC、^GSPC）。

title: General Motors follows Ford's lead into the battery business
title_zh: 通用汽车追随福特进军电池业务
summary: Yahoo Finance Senior Autos Reporter Pras Subramanian joins Julie Hyman on Market Catalysts to discuss General Motors' (GM) partnership with Peak Energy, placing a big bet on sodium-ion batteries.
summary_zh: 雅虎财经高级汽车记者 Pras Subramanian 与 Market Catalysts 的 Julie Hyman 一起讨论通用汽车 (GM) 与 Peak Energy 的合作关系，并在钠离子电池上下了重注。
